name: Review account overview and place a simulated paper trade
description: Checks dashboard entry shows the paper balance and market orders reserve demo funds, update open positions, and realize P/L on close.
steps: Open the dashboard and review the $10,000 simulated starting balance
Select Trading desk
Enter a demo margin amount of 100 and keep Market order selected
Place a BUY order and review the position, available balance and changing simulated P/L
Close the paper position
expected: Dashboard entry shows the overview and demo balance. The open position is simulated, available balance decreases by margin, and closing returns margin plus simulated P/L and updates realized P/L. No external order is sent.

name: Create and manage a simulated limit order
description: Verifies a limit order can be queued, filled at its demo limit price, or cancelled without contacting a broker.
steps: Select Trading desk, choose Limit order, and enter a positive limit price
Submit a SELL paper order
Review the pending order in Positions & open orders
Use Fill or Cancel and review the resulting simulated state
expected: The limit order appears as a pending demo record and can be filled into a paper position or cancelled. No external order is transmitted.

name: Submit demo deposit and withdrawal requests
description: Checks demo requests and simulated approval update only the browser ledger while preventing withdrawals above available funds.
steps: Open Deposit & withdraw and submit a demo deposit request
Enable Demo control mode and approve the pending deposit
Submit a withdrawal larger than the available demo balance and review the validation message
Submit a valid demo withdrawal using a label only, then approve and complete it
Review transaction history
expected: Deposit requests remain pending until a simulated approval credits the paper ledger. Withdrawals above available funds are rejected; valid requests reserve demo funds and progress through statuses. No real addresses, bank details, or money transfers are used.

name: Retain the browser paper ledger and reset demo data
covers: transaction and trade records are simulated
description: Ensures demo ledger state can be revisited in the same browser and reset without implying a server-side trading account.
steps: Place a paper trade or create a demo transaction
Refresh the dashboard
Review the demo ledger and records
Open Account and reset the demo ledger
expected: The same browser retains only its simulated ledger data; reset clears demo positions, requests and history and restores the starting paper balance.

name: View certificate and submit a support ticket
covers: Resend email delivery to both official addresses
signed Resend delivery webhook status updates
description: Checks the About page certificate and sends a support request through the backend email route.
steps: Open About Us and review the company details and certificate frame
Open and close View Full Certificate
Use the footer Verify Certificate / Company Registration link
Open Contact Us and check both emails, registered office and company number
Enter a name, valid email, subject and message in Submit a Support Ticket
Submit the form and read the confirmation modal
expected: The company details and certificate remain readable. Contact information is shown, a synthetic honeypot submission is safely discarded, the endpoint limits each source to five tickets per 15-minute window, and valid signed Resend delivery events update archived ticket status. When Resend accepts a real ticket for both official addresses, the exact ticket-logged confirmation appears.

name: Use the separated account and practice routes
covers: left-aligned plan labels and right-aligned values
live price and percentage change display
market ticker quotes and percentage moves
market-session status and data timing disclosure
hero background video with readable overlay
animated canvas fallback behind hero text
reduced-motion preference support for hero canvas
updated Live Managed Strategy Portfolios heading
strategy allocation opens wallet top-up modal for registered users
top-up explains funding provider is not connected
description: Checks account route separation and that visitors can open the clearly labeled practice trading view without entering registration details.
steps: Open the homepage and review the video hero, market overview, and accurate live-execution availability copy
Select PRACTICE TRADING and review the Practice Trading page, chart, and simulated trade labels
Return to the homepage and use Explore in practice on a strategy framework
Review the $10,000 example portfolio and its three allocations, pricing examples, and Bitcoin explainer
Select each market tab and confirm its TradingView mini-chart loads
Open #/register and review the Create Account form and practice-only notice
Open #/login and review the Account Login fields and provider-managed sign-in option
expected: The homepage retains the muted looping hero video and animated canvas fallback behind a dark readable overlay; the canvas respects reduced-motion preferences. The strategy section uses the Live Managed Strategy Portfolios heading and PRO STRATEGY FRAMEWORK labels while clearly stating that live execution awaits verified provider integration. Strategy cards open the wallet top-up modal for a signed-in user or route a visitor to login. The modal states funding is not connected and does not claim allocation or deposit success. The market activity feed shows an empty state until verified transaction events are connected. The homepage shows the $10,000 example allocation, aligned unverified pricing examples, and the Bitcoin explainer. TradingView tabs load market widgets with data timing caveats, and registration, login, and practice routes remain clearly distinguished.
